Is it cheaper to book directly on this website?

Yes. Booking direct always gets you our best available rate, plus perks like free cancellation and offers that aren't available on third-party platforms.

What is the check-in and check-out time?

Standard check-in is 2:00 PM and check-out is 12:00 PM (noon). Early check-in and late check-out can be arranged subject to availability.

What ID proof do I need at check-in?

One valid government-issued photo ID per guest — Aadhaar, Passport, Driving License, or Voter ID. International guests must present a passport.

What is the cancellation policy?

Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in. Some promotional rates are non-refundable — the exact policy is shown before you confirm your booking.

Is breakfast included in the room rate?

It depends on the rate you choose — complimentary breakfast is included on this property's standard rate; check the rate details before booking to confirm.

Is parking and WiFi available?

Yes, complimentary parking and high-speed WiFi are available at this property, along with 24x7 power backup and front desk support.

Do you offer discounted rates for corporate or group bookings?

Yes, corporate accounts and groups of 5+ rooms get special rates, GST-compliant invoicing, and a dedicated coordinator. Reach out to our reservations team.
